title: Reaggravation
summary: REAGGRAVA'TION, noun [re and aggravation.] In the Romish ecclesiastical law, the last monitory, published after three admonitions and before the last excommunication. Before they proceed to fulminate

inlines.v: REAGGRAVA'TION, noun [re and aggravation.] In the Romish ecclesiastical law, the last monitory, published after three admonitions and before the last excommunication. Before they proceed to fulminate the last excommunication, they publish an aggravation and a reaggravation
